why: Drops the named check on `_clearStyleCache`, the cache's only invalidation signal. If a jsdom upgrade renamed it, jsdom would call the new name and never this cache's wrapper, so the cache would never empty and every opted-in file would read stale `display` values with no error at all.
killedBy: computed-style-cache: the jsdom internals it hooks throws naming _clearStyleCache when a jsdom upgrade drops it
